archive: Inspired by NASA: May 14, 2024 · X8.7 flare

greenhouse_desc: Survival +6 / crew every 5 working days (1 power/day)
lab_desc: Use power to reach your research goal.

restart_body: This replaces your current saved outpost.
help_body:
1. Plan in the morning. Crew, then a building.
2. Standby returns the selected crew member.
3. A right-side building, then an empty tile.
4. Upgrades and shelter are morning choices.
5. Start work, then night notes, then morning.
6. Survival −2 daily. Water +1. Ren adds +1.
7. Plants harvest every 5 working days. Mio adds +3.
8. Research 10 strengthens the shield.
9. Research 20 grows harvests. Research is not spent.

Survive 15 days and gather 30 research to win.
Negative survival or power, or zero health, ends the run.
Crew and power are required. Shelter pauses production.
sources_body:
Warnings are inspired by NASA SDO’s observation
of an X8.7 flare on May 14, 2024, not live weather.

Survival combines water and food into one game resource.
Resource units, production and health effects are
game balance, not NASA measurements.
log_start: Touchdown! Assign your crew and start your first day.
shortage: Not enough power for every building to work.
protected: You sheltered safely through the flare!
loss_body:
A resource or health ran out.
Check forecasts and try a different crew plan.
win_body:
15 days survived. Research goal reached!
You are a resourceful outpost commander.
footer: JUNIOR ASTRONAUT MISSION TRAINER  ·  GODOT EDITION
resource_tip: Blue gains, red costs. Buildings use power in grid order.
plan_locked: Planning happens in the morning. See this day's results first.
day_started: Work has started. The results wait for night.
day_working: Daytime. The crew are following the morning plan.
unlock_shield_tip: At 10 research, a built shield cuts flare harm from 18 x 0.35 to 18 x 0.2. It applies on a morning you already have the research. Research is not spent.
unlock_crops_tip: At 20 research, base plant harvest goes from 6 to 9 per crew and level. It applies on a morning you already have the research. Research is not spent. Mio's +3 is extra.
